preconditions.description: The integer n is the length of the array b, where 2 ≤ n ≤ 140582.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 187126 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element b_i in the input array b satisfies 0 ≤ b_i ≤ 187126.
The input array b has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(a) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**18 for a_i in a) and all(a_i % a[(i % n) + 1] == b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a valid array a exists, stdout is 'YES' followed by a line containing n positive integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^18) such that for all i, a_i mod a_{(i mod n) + 1} equals b_i. Otherwise, stdout is 'NO'.
